raw_comment: I notice that in the mid-west areas and the lower part of Texas have severe to exceptional drought. I wonder why there's been little to no rain for most of the states, but also why it affects the mid-west more. I wonder if it's because they aren't as close to the oceans, so there's a lot less rain that makes it to the mid-west. I also notice that basically all of Florida isn't colored in along with Alaska, so I assume there's been rain in those places. This relates to my community because I didn't even realize that it hadn't rained in a while until my teachers and mom started pointing it out. It's been a lot cooler ever since it rained. When I checked the weather app today, it said it was supposed to feel like 22 degrees out. I think a good headline could be "The rise of Droughts in the Midwest of the United States."
